s: April 22, 2025 - Here comes the summary of millennial buying habits: They’re less about online shopping, and more about the omnichannel experience. t: How Your Equity Could Help Younger Generations Buy a Home - Admin Signature Realty
s: 1 day ago - And giving money to your loved one so they buy a home doesn’t mean putting your own future at risk. Even a small portion of your equity can put them in a position to finally get the keys to their first place – and, if you’re strategic about it, you’d still have a lot leftover for when you retire. With an estimated $68 and $84 trillion of wealth expected to transfer from older generations to younger ones over the next two decades, many families are already thinking differently about when and how that wealth will be passed down.

s: June 19, 2024 - Landing somewhere between Baby Boomers’ traditional values and innovative Millennial viewpoints, this generation is a true hybrid of our society. They tend to be pragmatic shoppers who appreciate both online convenience and physical stores. These consumers buy into new business models when it makes sense for them, but they don’t necessarily follow all consumer trends.
